text.name: ui_sp_schnitt_hint
text.text: Cuts per year for selected crop:

text.name: ui_sp_settings_allocStrategy_tooltip
text.text: How free fields are distributed across multiple underserved crops when there aren't enough fields for all of them.

text.name: ui_sp_settings_allocStrategy_desc_absolut
text.text: The crop missing the most liters overall gets a field first.

text.name: ui_sp_settings_allocStrategy_desc_prozent
text.text: The crop with the worst percentage coverage gets a field first.

text.name: ui_sp_settings_allocStrategy_desc_reihum
text.text: Round robin: each undersupplied crop gets a field in turn, one after another.

text.name: ui_sp_settings_fieldCut_tooltip
text.text: All fields numbered from this value up are excluded from plan and demand (0 = off). Local only, no multiplayer sync.

text.name: ui_sp_settings_seedinfo
text.text: Column 'GAME / REAL': Game value (from game data) and real-world reference in liters for the entire field. Real value: Derived from multiple public sources. For guidance only.

text.name: ui_sp_legend
text.text: Green = sown | Yellow = planned (sow) | White = free | Red = excluded | Light blue = release? | Blue = released

text.name: ui_sp_release_hint
text.text: Cyan = field of an oversupplied fruit: press Enter to release (this session only, re-set after restart)
